configuration.title: Project Budget Allocation
configuration.description: A project manager and a finance manager negotiate the allocation of a limited project budget while balancing project requirements and financial constraints.

agents.name: Project Manager
agents.role_description: Responsible for planning project activities and securing sufficient funding to complete essential deliverables successfully.
agents.goal: Secure at least 60 lakh INR for project activities while ensuring the total budget does not exceed 100 lakh INR.
constraints: At least 60 lakh INR must be allocated to project activities.
The total project budget must not exceed 100 lakh INR.

agents.name: Finance Manager
agents.role_description: Responsible for managing project expenditure, controlling financial risks, and ensuring that the proposed allocation remains within the approved budget.
agents.goal: Limit the allocation for project activities to a maximum of 80 lakh INR and keep total project spending within 100 lakh INR.
constraints: The allocation for project activities must not exceed 80 lakh INR.
Total project spending must not exceed 100 lakh INR.

history.reasoning: Project Manager opens with project_allocation 76.8, total_budget 100.0. As a Collaborative negotiator it moves towards a fair middle ground.
Finance Manager accepts the offer (project_allocation 76.8, total_budget 100.0) because it is within its limits and meets its current goal.
